title: CropperState
description: The full state of the image cropper. AI agents can read this to understand the current crop configuration and derive export parameters.

image.description: The source image information. Null until an image is loaded.

naturalWidth.description: The intrinsic width of the image in pixels.

naturalHeight.description: The intrinsic height of the image in pixels.

zoom.description: Zoom level. 1 = no zoom, 10 = maximum zoom.

flip.description: Flip state for horizontal and vertical axes.

horizontal.description: Whether the image is flipped horizontally.

vertical.description: Whether the image is flipped vertically.

cropRect.description: The crop rectangle in normalized coordinates (0-1 range).

x.description: Left edge position (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge).

y.description: Top edge position (0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge).

width.description: Width as a fraction of the image width.

height.description: Height as a fraction of the image height.
